segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ דְּבָרִים שֶׁאֵין חַיָּיבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מִשּׁוּם פִּיגּוּל, חַיָּיבִין עֲלֵיהֶן מִשּׁוּם נוֹתָר וּמִשּׁוּם טָמֵא; חוּץ מִן הַדָּם. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן מְחַיֵּיב בְּדָבָר שֶׁדַּרְכָּן לֶאֱכוֹל, אֲבָל הָעֵצִים וְהַלְּבוֹנָה וְהַקְּטוֹרֶת אֵין חַיָּיבִין עָלָיו מִשּׁוּם טוּמְאָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» Even with regard to those «items» enumerated in the previous mishna (42b) for «which one is not liable for» eating «them due to» violation of the prohibition of «piggul,» e.g., the handful, the frankincense, and the incense, «one is,» nevertheless, «liable for» eating «them due to» violation of the prohibition of «notar, and due to» violation of the prohibition against eating consecrated food while «ritually impure, except for the blood. Rabbi Shimon deems one liable for an item whose» typical «manner» is such that one «eats» it. «But» with regard to «the wood, the frankincense, and the incense, one is not liable for» eating «them due to» violation of the prohibition against eating a consecrated item while «ritually impure.»
